case_number: 2024 INSC 483; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1943 OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (CRL) No. 6006 OF 2019)
summary: Prosecution of public servant under Prevention of Corruption Act; cognizance under Section 319 CrPC requires prior sanction under Section 19 PC Act; mandatory requirement; sanction sine qua non; trial court erred in summoning without sanction; High Court rightly set aside summoning order; appeal dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.13(2)
Paul Varghese v. State of Kerala
Surinderjit Singh Mand v. State of Punjab
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court order upheld; cognizance order under Section 319 CrPC set aside for non-fulfillment of mandatory sanction requirement under Section 19 PC Act.
